verdict.rationale: No dedicated export or offboarding feature is documented. The data is reachable programmatically through a public API with versioned OpenAPI 3.1 specs, official SDKs, and an MCP server that can look up products, customers, subscriptions and orders. That makes a self-built JSON extraction possible, and the Apache-2.0 open-source codebase reduces lock-in. The only documented migration path is inbound (migrating to Polar). Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, export in standard open formats such as CSV/JSON dumps, coverage of all data types including usage events and payment history, documented migration-out or offboarding guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
